import { useAtomValue } from 'jotai'
import { useMemo } from 'react'

import { resolveDashboardLoadState } from '@/app/helpers/mappers/resolveDashboardLoadState'
import { useGetFundDiagnosticsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/apis/queries/useGetFundDiagnosticsQuery'
import { useDashboardQuality } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/services/useDashboardQuality'
import type { FundDiagnostics } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/types/fundDiagnostics.type'
import { useGetManualPriceOverridesQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/apis/queries/useGetManualPriceOverridesQuery'
import { useGetPipelineErrorsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/apis/queries/useGetPipelineErrorsQuery'
import type { ManualPriceOverride } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/types/manualPriceOverride.type'
import type { PipelineError } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/types/pipelineError.type'
import { useSortedPositions } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/holdings/features/positions/services/useSortedPositions'
import { dashboardPositionSortDirectionAtom } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/holdings/features/positions/stores/dashboardPositionsTable/dashboardPositionSortDirectionAtom'
import { dashboardPositionSortKeyAtom } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/holdings/features/positions/stores/dashboardPositionsTable/dashboardPositionSortKeyAtom'
import { useOverviewComparison } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/overview/services/useOverviewComparison'
import { useDashboardPerformance } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/performance/services/useDashboardPerformance'
import { useGetAnnualIncomeSavingsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/wealth/apis/queries/useGetAnnualIncomeSavingsQuery'
import { useGetMonthlyOperationsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/wealth/apis/queries/useGetMonthlyOperationsQuery'
import type { AnnualIncomeSavingsPoint } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/wealth/types/annualIncomeSavingsPoint.type'
import { useDashboardWealth } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/wealth/services/useDashboardWealth'
import type { MonthlyOperationsByMonth } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/wealth/types/monthlyOperation.type'
import { useGetAllocationRowsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetAllocationRowsQuery'
import { useGetBrokerageCashHistoryQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetBrokerageCashHistoryQuery'
import { useGetDashboardDataQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetDashboardDataQuery'
import { useGetFundHoldingsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetFundHoldingsQuery'
import { useGetPortfolioHistoryQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetPortfolioHistoryQuery'
import { useGetPositionsQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetPositionsQuery'
import { useGetSavingCapacityQuery } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/apis/queries/useGetSavingCapacityQuery'
import { buildDashboardSourceData } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/helpers/mappers/buildDashboardSourceData'
import { useDashboardHistory } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/services/useDashboardHistory'
import { usePortfolioPositions } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/services/usePortfolioPositions'
import { dashboardFiltersAtom } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/stores/dashboardFilters/dashboardFiltersAtom'
import { dashboardActiveTabAtom } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/stores/dashboardNavigation/dashboardActiveTabAtom'
import { dashboardHoldingsViewAtom } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/stores/dashboardNavigation/dashboardHoldingsViewAtom'
import type { CashHistoryPoint } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/cashHistoryPoint.type'
import type { DashboardData } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/dashboardData.type'
import type { FundHoldingsData } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/fundHoldingsData.type'
import type { PortfolioHistoryPoint } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/portfolioHistoryPoint.type'
import type { RawIsinRows } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/rawIsinData.type'
import type { RawPositionRow } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/rawPosition.type'
import type { SavingCapacityPoint } from '@/domains/portfolio/shared/types/savingCapacityPoint.type'

// eslint-disable-next-line complexity, max-lines-per-function -- reviewed: 2026-10-27; This shell facade composes feature-owned models and query fallbacks; its length is the memoized output contract and dependency list.
export function useDashboardViewModel() {
  const activeTab = useAtomValue(dashboardActiveTabAtom)
  const filters = useAtomValue(dashboardFiltersAtom)
  const holdingsView = useAtomValue(dashboardHoldingsViewAtom)
  const sortDir = useAtomValue(dashboardPositionSortDirectionAtom)
  const sortKey = useAtomValue(dashboardPositionSortKeyAtom)
  const dashboardQuery = useGetDashboardDataQuery()
  const historyQuery = useGetPortfolioHistoryQuery()
  const cashHistoryQuery = useGetBrokerageCashHistoryQuery()
  const allPositionsQuery = useGetPositionsQuery()
  const pipelineErrorsQuery = useGetPipelineErrorsQuery()
  const manualPriceOverridesQuery = useGetManualPriceOverridesQuery()
  const monthlyOpsQuery = useGetMonthlyOperationsQuery()
  const rawAllocationQuery = useGetAllocationRowsQuery()
  const fundHoldingsQuery = useGetFundHoldingsQuery()
  const fundDiagnosticsQuery = useGetFundDiagnosticsQuery()
  const { data: fundHoldings = EMPTY_FUND_HOLDINGS } = fundHoldingsQuery
  const { data: fundDiagnostics = EMPTY_FUND_DIAGNOSTICS } =
    fundDiagnosticsQuery
  const fundData = useMemo(
    () => ({
      ...fundHoldings,
      ...fundDiagnostics,
    }),
    [fundHoldings, fundDiagnostics],
  )
  const savingCapacityQuery = useGetSavingCapacityQuery(filters.accounts)
  const { data: savingCapacity = EMPTY_SAVING_CAPACITY } = savingCapacityQuery
  const savingCapacityLoading = savingCapacityQuery.isPending
  const savingCapacityError = savingCapacityQuery.error
  const annualIncomeSavingsQuery = useGetAnnualIncomeSavingsQuery()
  const { data: dashboardData = EMPTY_DASHBOARD_DATA } = dashboardQuery
  const { positions, rawPositions, rawOperations, accountLabels } =
    dashboardData
  const { data: history = EMPTY_PORTFOLIO_HISTORY } = historyQuery
  const { data: cashHistory = EMPTY_CASH_HISTORY } = cashHistoryQuery
  const { data: allPositionRows = EMPTY_RAW_POSITIONS } = allPositionsQuery
  const { data: pipelineErrors = EMPTY_ERRORS } = pipelineErrorsQuery
  const pipelineErrorsLoading = pipelineErrorsQuery.isPending
  const { data: manualPriceOverrides = EMPTY_MANUAL_PRICE_OVERRIDES } =
    manualPriceOverridesQuery
  const { data: allMonthlyOps = EMPTY_MONTHLY_OPS } = monthlyOpsQuery
  const { data: allocationRows = EMPTY_RAW_ISIN_DATA } = rawAllocationQuery
  const rawAllocationData = useMemo(
    () => ({
      ...allocationRows,
      loading: rawAllocationQuery.isPending,
    }),
    [allocationRows, rawAllocationQuery.isPending],
  )
  const { data: annualIncomeSavings = EMPTY_ANNUAL_INCOME_SAVINGS } =
    annualIncomeSavingsQuery

  const {
    accountFilterLabels,
    accountToType,
    allAccounts,
    allAccountTypes,
    allOperationTypes,
    enrichedHistory,
  } = useMemo(
    () =>
      buildDashboardSourceData({
        accountLabels,
        cashHistory,
        history,
        positions,
      }),
    [accountLabels, cashHistory, history, positions],
  )

  const {
    currentPositions,
    latestAccountPositions,
    periodEndFundHoldings,
    periodPositions,
    tableFiltered,
  } = usePortfolioPositions({
    filters,
    fundData,
    positions,
    rawOperations,
    rawPositions,
  })

  const tableData = useSortedPositions(
    tableFiltered,
    filters.hideClosedPositions,
    allAccountTypes,
    sortKey,
    sortDir,
  )

  const {
    accountHistory,
    demoPresetActive,
    demoPresetSelection,
    displayedHistory,
    globalTri,
    irrStatus,
  } = useDashboardHistory({
    allAccounts,
    allPositionRows,
    enrichedHistory,
    filters,
  })

  const {
    accountTypeData,
    displayedAnnualIncomeSavings,
    displayedTypeHistory,
    monthlyOps,
    trailingSavings,
    trailingYearComparison,
    typeHistory,
    wealthDrivers,
  } = useDashboardWealth({
    savingCapacity,
    allMonthlyOps,
    annualIncomeSavings,
    currentPositions,
    filters,
  })
  const { overviewComparison, rollingThreeYearTriComparison } =
    useOverviewComparison({
      accountHistory,
      filters,
      fundHoldingsHistory: fundData.history,
      rawOperations,
      rawPositions,
      savingCapacity,
    })

  const {
    passiveIncome,
    performance,
    trailingIncome,
    passiveIncomeLoading,
    passiveIncomeError,
    passiveIncomeUpdating,
  } = useDashboardPerformance({
    currentPositions,
    displayedHistory,
    filters,
    periodPositions,
  })
  const {
    qualitySummary,
    scopedFundQuality,
    scopedManualPriceOverrides,
    scopedPipelineErrors,
  } = useDashboardQuality({
    activeTab,
    filters,
    fundData,
    holdingsView,
    latestAccountPositions,
    manualPriceOverrides,
    pipelineErrors,
    pipelineErrorsLoading,
    rawAllocationData,
    tableFiltered,
  })

  const loadState = useMemo(
    () =>
      resolveDashboardLoadState([
        { error: dashboardQuery.error, isPending: dashboardQuery.isPending },
        { error: historyQuery.error, isPending: historyQuery.isPending },
        {
          error: cashHistoryQuery.error,
          isPending: cashHistoryQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: allPositionsQuery.error,
          isPending: allPositionsQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: pipelineErrorsQuery.error,
          isPending: pipelineErrorsQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: manualPriceOverridesQuery.error,
          isPending: manualPriceOverridesQuery.isPending,
        },
        { error: monthlyOpsQuery.error, isPending: monthlyOpsQuery.isPending },
        {
          error: rawAllocationQuery.error,
          isPending: rawAllocationQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: fundHoldingsQuery.error,
          isPending: fundHoldingsQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: fundDiagnosticsQuery.error,
          isPending: fundDiagnosticsQuery.isPending,
        },
        {
          error: annualIncomeSavingsQuery.error,
          isPending: annualIncomeSavingsQuery.isPending,
        },
        { isPending: savingCapacityLoading, error: savingCapacityError },
        { isPending: passiveIncomeLoading, error: passiveIncomeError },
      ]),
    [
      dashboardQuery.error,
      dashboardQuery.isPending,
      historyQuery.error,
      historyQuery.isPending,
      cashHistoryQuery.error,
      cashHistoryQuery.isPending,
      allPositionsQuery.error,
      allPositionsQuery.isPending,
      pipelineErrorsQuery.error,
      pipelineErrorsQuery.isPending,
      manualPriceOverridesQuery.error,
      manualPriceOverridesQuery.isPending,
      monthlyOpsQuery.error,
      monthlyOpsQuery.isPending,
      rawAllocationQuery.error,
      rawAllocationQuery.isPending,
      fundHoldingsQuery.error,
      fundHoldingsQuery.isPending,
      fundDiagnosticsQuery.error,
      fundDiagnosticsQuery.isPending,
      annualIncomeSavingsQuery.error,
      annualIncomeSavingsQuery.isPending,
      savingCapacityLoading,
      savingCapacityError,
      passiveIncomeLoading,
      passiveIncomeError,
    ],
  )
  const error = loadState.status === 'error' ? loadState.message : null
  const loading = loadState.status === 'loading'
  const updating =
    savingCapacityQuery.isPlaceholderData || passiveIncomeUpdating

  return useMemo(
    () => ({
      loadState,
      accountFilterLabels,
      accountLabels,
      accountToType,
      accountTypeData,
      allAccounts,
      allAccountTypes,
      allOperationTypes,
      demoPresetActive,
      demoPresetSelection,
      displayedAnnualIncomeSavings,
      displayedHistory,
      displayedTypeHistory,
      error,
      fundData,
      globalTri,
      irrStatus,
      latestAccountPositions,
      loading,
      updating,
      monthlyOps,
      overviewComparison,
      passiveIncome,
      performance,
      periodEndFundHoldings,
      qualitySummary,
      rawAllocationData,
      rawOperations,
      rawPositions,
      rollingThreeYearTriComparison,
      scopedFundQuality,
      scopedManualPriceOverrides,
      scopedPipelineErrors,
      pipelineErrorsLoading,
      tableData,
      trailingIncome,
      trailingSavings,
      trailingYearComparison,
      typeHistory,
      useGroupedPositionsTable: allAccountTypes.length > 0,
      wealthDrivers,
      currentPositions,
    }),
    [
      loadState,
      accountFilterLabels,
      accountLabels,
      accountToType,
      accountTypeData,
      allAccounts,
      allAccountTypes,
      allOperationTypes,
      currentPositions,
      demoPresetActive,
      demoPresetSelection,
      displayedAnnualIncomeSavings,
      displayedHistory,
      displayedTypeHistory,
      error,
      fundData,
      globalTri,
      irrStatus,
      latestAccountPositions,
      loading,
      updating,
      monthlyOps,
      overviewComparison,
      passiveIncome,
      performance,
      periodEndFundHoldings,
      pipelineErrorsLoading,
      qualitySummary,
      rawAllocationData,
      rawOperations,
      rawPositions,
      rollingThreeYearTriComparison,
      scopedFundQuality,
      scopedManualPriceOverrides,
      scopedPipelineErrors,
      tableData,
      trailingIncome,
      trailingSavings,
      trailingYearComparison,
      typeHistory,
      wealthDrivers,
    ],
  )
}

const EMPTY_DASHBOARD_DATA: DashboardData = {
  positions: [],
  rawPositions: [],
  rawOperations: [],
  accountLabels: {},
}

const EMPTY_RAW_ISIN_DATA: RawIsinRows = {
  geo: [],
  secteur: [],
  currency: [],
  classe: [],
}

const EMPTY_ANNUAL_INCOME_SAVINGS: AnnualIncomeSavingsPoint[] = []
const EMPTY_CASH_HISTORY: CashHistoryPoint[] = []
const EMPTY_SAVING_CAPACITY: SavingCapacityPoint[] = []
const EMPTY_ERRORS: PipelineError[] = []
const EMPTY_FUND_HOLDINGS: FundHoldingsData = {
  holdings: [],
  history: [],
  statuses: [],
}
const EMPTY_FUND_DIAGNOSTICS: FundDiagnostics = {
  report: null,
  snapshots: [],
  unresolved: [],
}
const EMPTY_MANUAL_PRICE_OVERRIDES: ManualPriceOverride[] = []
const EMPTY_MONTHLY_OPS: MonthlyOperationsByMonth = new Map()
const EMPTY_PORTFOLIO_HISTORY: PortfolioHistoryPoint[] = []
const EMPTY_RAW_POSITIONS: RawPositionRow[] = []

import { aggregateReliabilityTone } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/analysisReliability/aggregateReliabilityTone'
import type { AnalysisReliabilityTone } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/analysisReliability/analysisReliability.types'
import { percentageReliabilityTone } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/analysisReliability/percentageReliabilityTone'
import { pipelineReliabilityTone } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/analysisReliability/pipelineReliabilityTone'
import { pipelineStatusLabel } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/analysisReliability/pipelineStatusLabel'
import type { AccountCoverage } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/computeAllocationCoverage/computeAllocationCoverage.types'

import type { ScopedFundQualityData } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/helpers/quality/scopeFundQualityData/scopeFundQualityData.types'
import type { QualityThemeId } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/features/assessment/types/dataQuality.type'
import type { ManualPriceOverride } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/types/manualPriceOverride.type'
import type { PipelineError } from '@/domains/portfolio/features/data-quality/shared/types/pipelineError.type'
import { partitionPercentages } from '@/shared/helpers/calculators/partitionPercentages'

import { buildAnalysisReliabilityMetrics } from './buildAnalysisReliabilityMetrics'

// eslint-disable-next-line complexity -- reviewed: 2026-10-27; This joins classification, look-through and pipeline reliability; tone policies and display metrics are delegated to their existing helpers.
export function buildDataQualitySummary({
  allocationLoading,
  coverage,
  pipelineErrorsLoading,
  scopedFundQuality,
  scopedManualPriceOverrides,
  scopedPipelineErrors,
}: BuildDataQualitySummaryInput) {
  const classificationMappedValue = coverage.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.allocated,
    0,
  )
  const classificationUnmappedValue = coverage.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.unallocated,
    0,
  )
  const classificationNotApplicableValue = coverage.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.notApplicable,
    0,
  )
  const classificationApplicableValue =
    classificationMappedValue + classificationUnmappedValue
  const classificationReliabilityPct =
    classificationApplicableValue > 0
      ? (classificationMappedValue / classificationApplicableValue) * 100
      : null
  const unallocatedPct = allocationLoading
    ? null
    : partitionPercentages([
        classificationMappedValue,
        classificationUnmappedValue,
        classificationNotApplicableValue,
      ])[1]

  const hasFundValidationError = scopedFundQuality.statuses.some(
    (status) => status.validationStatus === 'error',
  )
  const unresolvedFundValue = scopedFundQuality.report
    ? scopedFundQuality.report.undisclosedFundValue +
      scopedFundQuality.report.opaqueValue
    : 0
  const identifiedFundValue = scopedFundQuality.report
    ? scopedFundQuality.report.directIdentifiedValue +
      scopedFundQuality.report.decomposedValue
    : 0
  const fundExposurePercentages = computeFundExposurePercentages(
    identifiedFundValue,
    unresolvedFundValue,
    scopedFundQuality.notApplicableValue,
  )
  const underlyingReliabilityPct = scopedFundQuality.report
    ? fundExposurePercentages.identified
    : null
  const underlyingCritical =
    hasFundValidationError ||
    scopedFundQuality.report?.feasibilityStatus === 'limited'
  const classificationMetricTone = percentageReliabilityTone(
    allocationLoading ? null : classificationReliabilityPct,
  )
  let underlyingMetricTone: AnalysisReliabilityTone = percentageReliabilityTone(
    scopedFundQuality.report ? underlyingReliabilityPct : null,
  )
  if (underlyingCritical) underlyingMetricTone = 'critical'
  else if (
    scopedFundQuality.report?.feasibilityStatus === 'pending_repeatability'
  ) {
    underlyingMetricTone = 'warning'
  }
  const diversificationReliabilityTone = aggregateReliabilityTone([
    classificationMetricTone,
    underlyingMetricTone,
  ])
  const diversificationQualityTheme = weakestQualityTheme([
    { theme: 'classification', tone: classificationMetricTone },
    { theme: 'lookthrough', tone: underlyingMetricTone },
  ])

  const scopedPipelineErrorCount = scopedPipelineErrors.filter(
    (item) => item.level === 'error',
  ).length
  const scopedPipelineWarningCount =
    scopedPipelineErrors.length - scopedPipelineErrorCount
  const portfolioDataTone = pipelineReliabilityTone({
    errorCount: scopedPipelineErrorCount,
    warningCount: scopedPipelineWarningCount,
    loading: pipelineErrorsLoading,
  })
  const portfolioDataStatus = pipelineStatusLabel({
    errorCount: scopedPipelineErrorCount,
    warningCount: scopedPipelineWarningCount,
    loading: pipelineErrorsLoading,
  })
  const overviewReliabilityTone = aggregateReliabilityTone([
    portfolioDataTone,
    classificationMetricTone,
    underlyingMetricTone,
  ])
  const overviewQualityTheme = weakestQualityTheme([
    { theme: 'pipeline', tone: portfolioDataTone },
    { theme: 'classification', tone: classificationMetricTone },
    { theme: 'lookthrough', tone: underlyingMetricTone },
  ])
  const qualityCount =
    Number(scopedPipelineErrors.length > 0) +
    Number(scopedManualPriceOverrides.length > 0) +
    Number(hasMaterialQualityGap(unallocatedPct ?? 0)) +
    Number(
      hasFundValidationError ||
        hasMaterialQualityGap(fundExposurePercentages.unresolved),
    )

  const reliabilityMetrics = buildAnalysisReliabilityMetrics({
    allocationLoading,
    classificationReliabilityPct,
    classificationMappedValue,
    classificationMetricTone,
    underlyingReliabilityPct,
    identifiedFundValue,
    underlyingMetricTone,
    portfolioDataStatus,
    portfolioDataTone,
  })

  return {
    ...reliabilityMetrics,
    classificationMappedValue,
    classificationMetricTone,
    classificationReliabilityPct,
    diversificationQualityTheme,
    diversificationReliabilityTone,
    hasFundValidationError,
    hasPipelineError: scopedPipelineErrorCount > 0,
    identifiedFundValue,
    overviewQualityTheme,
    overviewReliabilityTone,
    portfolioDataStatus,
    portfolioDataTone,
    qualityCount,
    scopedPipelineErrorCount,
    scopedPipelineWarningCount,
    underlyingMetricTone,
    underlyingReliabilityPct,
  }
}

type BuildDataQualitySummaryInput = {
  allocationLoading: boolean
  coverage: AccountCoverage[]
  pipelineErrorsLoading: boolean
  scopedFundQuality: ScopedFundQualityData
  scopedManualPriceOverrides: ManualPriceOverride[]
  scopedPipelineErrors: PipelineError[]
}

const RELIABILITY_PRIORITY: Record<AnalysisReliabilityTone, number> = {
  healthy: 0,
  warning: 1,
  unavailable: 2,
  critical: 3,
}

function weakestQualityTheme(
  metrics: Array<{ theme: QualityThemeId; tone: AnalysisReliabilityTone }>,
): QualityThemeId {
  return metrics.reduce((mostRelevant, candidate) =>
    RELIABILITY_PRIORITY[candidate.tone] >
    RELIABILITY_PRIORITY[mostRelevant.tone]
      ? candidate
      : mostRelevant,
  ).theme
}

import { type ComponentPropsWithoutRef, createElement } from 'react'

import type { ControlProps } from '@/shared/ui/controlProps'
import { SURFACE_VARIANTS } from '@/shared/ui/surfaceAppearance/surfaceVariants'
import { TEXT_ALIGNMENTS } from '@/shared/ui/textAppearance/textAlignments'
import type { TextTone } from '@/shared/ui/textAppearance/textAppearance.types'
import { TEXT_TONES } from '@/shared/ui/textAppearance/textTones'

// eslint-disable-next-line complexity -- reviewed: 2026-10-27; Element-specific structure, padding and semantic appearance belong to the same Surface primitive.
export function Surface<T extends SurfaceTag = 'div'>({
  as,
  variant,
  tone,
  align,
  ...props
}: SurfaceProps<T>) {
  let layoutClass = 'block h-full'
  if (as === 'span') layoutClass = 'inline-flex h-full'
  if (
    as === 'span' &&
    (variant === 'statusFrame' ||
      variant === 'statusCanvasFrame' ||
      variant === 'overlay')
  )
    layoutClass =
      variant === 'overlay'
        ? 'block h-full w-full'
        : 'grid size-full place-items-center'
  if (as === 'table') layoutClass = 'w-full'
  else if (as === 'thead') layoutClass = 'sticky top-0 z-10'
  else if (as === 'tr' || as === 'tbody' || as === 'td') layoutClass = ''
  return createElement(as ?? 'div', {
    ...props,
    className: [
      layoutClass,
      SURFACE_VARIANTS[variant],
      [
        'chart',
        'card',
        'panel',
        'contentCard',
        'smallCard',
        'subduedCard',
        'indicatorCard',
        'inset',
        'insetContent',
        'canvasOutline',
        'raisedInset',
        'selectionPanel',
      ].includes(variant) && 'p-4',
      ['empty', 'compactEmpty', 'emptyCaption'].includes(variant) && 'p-6',
      [
        'microFooter',
        'captionFooter',
        'sectionStart',
        'strongSectionStart',
      ].includes(variant) && 'pt-3',
      ['sectionEnd', 'strongSectionEnd'].includes(variant) && 'pb-3',
      [
        'quietChip',
        'highlightedChip',
        'quietCount',
        'errorCount',
        'warningCount',
        'warningLabel',
      ].includes(variant) && 'px-2 py-1',
      tone && TEXT_TONES[tone],
      align && TEXT_ALIGNMENTS[align],
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' '),
  })
}

type SurfaceTag =
  | 'p'
  | 'div'
  | 'span'
  | 'section'
  | 'article'
  | 'header'
  | 'footer'
  | 'aside'
  | 'main'
  | 'li'
  | 'table'
  | 'thead'
  | 'tbody'
  | 'tr'
  | 'td'

type SurfaceProps<T extends SurfaceTag> = ControlProps<
  ComponentPropsWithoutRef<T>
> & {
  as?: T
  variant: keyof typeof SURFACE_VARIANTS
  tone?: TextTone
  align?: keyof typeof TEXT_ALIGNMENTS
}

import { createElement } from 'react'

import { LAYOUT_AFTER } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutAfter'
import { LAYOUT_ALIGNMENTS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutAlignments'
import { LAYOUT_BEFORE } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutBefore'
import { LAYOUT_COLUMNS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutColumns'
import { LAYOUT_FLOWS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutFlows'
import { LAYOUT_GAPS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutGaps'
import { LAYOUT_HEIGHTS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutHeights'
import { LAYOUT_HIDDEN_FROM } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutHiddenFrom'
import { LAYOUT_INSETS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutInsets'
import { LAYOUT_JUSTIFICATION } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutJustification'
import { LAYOUT_OVERFLOW } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutOverflow'
import { LAYOUT_PLACEMENTS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutPlacements'
import { LAYOUT_PRESETS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutPresets'
import { LAYOUT_RESPONSIVENESS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutResponsiveness'
import { LAYOUT_SIZING } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutSizing'
import { LAYOUT_WIDTHS } from '@/shared/ui/layoutAppearance/layoutWidths'

import type { LayoutProps, LayoutTag } from './layout.types'

// eslint-disable-next-line complexity -- reviewed: 2026-10-27; Closed layout tokens map directly to classes in one primitive; splitting each option would add indirection.
export function Layout<T extends LayoutTag = 'div'>({
  as,
  flow,
  gap,
  inset,
  spaceBefore,
  spaceAfter,
  align,
  justify,
  sizing,
  width,
  height,
  columns,
  arrangement,
  overflow,
  placement,
  hiddenUntil,
  hideFrom,
  ...props
}: LayoutProps<T>) {
  return createElement(as ?? 'div', {
    ...props,
    className:
      [
        flow &&
          (flow === 'row' && as === 'span'
            ? 'inline-flex'
            : LAYOUT_FLOWS[flow]),
        gap && LAYOUT_GAPS[gap],
        inset && LAYOUT_INSETS[inset],
        spaceBefore && LAYOUT_BEFORE[spaceBefore],
        spaceAfter && LAYOUT_AFTER[spaceAfter],
        align && LAYOUT_ALIGNMENTS[align],
        justify && LAYOUT_JUSTIFICATION[justify],
        sizing && LAYOUT_SIZING[sizing],
        width && LAYOUT_WIDTHS[width],
        height && LAYOUT_HEIGHTS[height],
        columns != null && LAYOUT_COLUMNS[columns],
        arrangement && LAYOUT_PRESETS[arrangement],
        overflow && LAYOUT_OVERFLOW[overflow],
        placement && LAYOUT_PLACEMENTS[placement],
        hiddenUntil && LAYOUT_RESPONSIVENESS[hiddenUntil],
        hideFrom && LAYOUT_HIDDEN_FROM[hideFrom],
        height === 'icon' && !width && 'w-4',
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ') || undefined,
  })
}
